latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of beepack skill.

- Instantly search Beepack for reusable, production-tested JavaScript API packages before coding.
- Explore package details, usage instructions, and community feedback via simple API endpoints.
- Submit feedback or suggest improvements directly for packages you use.
- Avoid duplicate work: publish new packages only if no equivalent exists.
- Packages are security scanned, standalone ESM modules with minimal dependencies for reliable integration.
